8
Asɛnka
1 # Luk 4.43 Na ɛbaa sɛ yei akyiri no, ɔkɔfaa nkuro ne nkuraa nyinaa mu, kaa Nyankopɔn ahennie ho asɛmpa kyerɛe, na dummienu no ka ne ho, 2#Mar 15.40-41; 16.9 ne mmaa bi a wasa wɔn ahonhommɔne ne ahoɔmmerɛ, wɔn ne Maria a wɔfrɛ no Magdalene a ɔtuu ahonhommɔne nson firii ne mu no 3ne Yohana, Herode fiepanin Kusa yere, ne Susana ne afoforɔ bebree a wɔde wɔn ahodeɛ bi somm no.
Ogufoɔ ho bɛ
(Mateo 13.1-23; Marko 4.1-20)
4Na nkurɔfokuo pii boaboaa wɔn ano ne wɔn a wɔfiri nkuro no nyinaa mu baa ne nkyɛn no, ɔbuu wɔn bɛ sɛ: 5Ogufoɔ bi firii adi kɔguu n’aba. Na ɔreguo no, ebi kɔguu kwankyɛn; na wɔtiatiaa so, na ewiem nnomaa bɛsosɔe. 6Na ebi kɔguu ɔbotan so; na ɛfifiriiɛ no, ɛhyee, ɛfiri sɛ ɛnni fonwunu ntira. 7Na ebi kɔguu nkasɛɛ mu; na nkasɛɛ no ne no fifirii, na ɛmiaa no. 8Na ebi kɔguu asase pa mu; na ɛfifirii, na ɛsoo aba ahodoɔ ɔha. Na ɔkaa saa no, ɔteaa mu sɛ: Deɛ ɔwɔ aso bɛtie no, ma no ntie!
Ogufoɔ ho bɛ no asekyerɛ
9Na n’asuafoɔ no bisaa no sɛ: Ɛbɛ yi ase ne sɛn? 10#Yes 6.9-10 Na ɔse: Mo deɛ, wɔde ama mo sɛ monhunu Nyankopɔn ahennie mu ahuntasɛm no; na wɔn a aka deɛ, wɔde ama wɔn mmebuo mu,
na wɔahunu, na wɔanhunu mu,
na wɔate, nanso wɔante aseɛ.
11 # 1 Pe 1.23 Na ɛbɛ no ni: Aba a wɔguo no ne Nyankopɔn asɛm. 12Ɔkwankyɛn deɛ no ne wɔn a wɔteɛ; na ɔbonsam ba bɛyi asɛm no firi wɔn akoma mu, na wɔannye anni na wɔannye wɔn nkwa. 13Ɔbotan so deɛ no ne wɔn a wɔte asɛm no a, wɔde anigyeɛ gyeɛ, nanso yeinom nni nhini, na wɔgye di ma no kyɛre kakra, na sɔhwɛ berɛ ba a, na wɔagyae. 14Na deɛ ɛguu nkasɛɛ mu no ne wɔn a wɔteɛ, na wɔnam asetena yi mu dadwene ne haw ne ahonya ne anigyedeɛ mu na ɛmia wɔn, na wɔn aba no mmere nwie. 15#Aso 16.14; Heb 10.36 Na asase pa mu deɛ no ne wɔn a wɔde akoma pa a ɛyɛ te asɛm no, na wɔde sie, na wɔnam boasetɔ mu so aba.
Kanea adwuma
(Marko 4.21-25)
16 # Mat 5.15 Na obi nsɔ kanea mfa adeɛ nkata so, anaasɛ ɔmfa nsi mpa ase; na mmom ɔde si kaneadua so, na wɔn a wɔkɔ mu hɔ ahunu kanea no. 17#Mat 10.26 Na biribi nni kokoam a wɔrenyi no adie, na ahunta a wɔrenhunu, na ɛrenna adie. 18#Luk 19.26 Enti monhwɛ yie sɛdeɛ mote asɛm no fa. Na obiara a ɔwɔ no na wɔde bɛma no; na deɛ ɔnni bi deɛ, deɛ ɔsusu sɛ ɔwɔ mpo, wɔbɛgye ne nsam.
Yesu abusuafoɔ
(Mateo 12.46-50; Marko 3.31-35)
19Na ne na ne ne nuanom baa ne nkyɛn, na nkyeresoɔ no nti wɔantumi ammɛn no. 20Na wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Wo na ne wo nuanom gyina mfikyire pɛ sɛ wɔhu woɔ. 21Na ɔbua see wɔn sɛ: Me na ne me nuanom ne wɔn a wɔte Nyankopɔn asɛm na wɔdi soɔ.
Ahum asebrɛ
(Mateo 8.18; 8.23-27; Marko 4.35-41)
22Na ɛbaa sɛ da bi ɔne n’asuafoɔ no kɔtenaa kodoɔ mu, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Momma yɛntwa nkɔ ɔtadeɛ no agya nohoa. Na wɔhare kɔe. 23Na wɔrekorɔ no, ɔdae. Na mframa kɛseɛ bi bɔɔ huu baa ɔtadeɛ no so, na nsuo bu faa wɔn so, na wɔwɔ amanehunu mu. 24Na wɔbaa ne nkyɛn bɛnyanee no sɛ: Owura, owura, yɛreyera! Na ɔsɔre teateaa mframa ne nsuo no aworɔ no; na ɛgyae yɛɛ dinn. 25Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Mo gyidie wɔ he? Na wɔsuroe, na ɛyɛɛ wɔn nwanwa, na wɔsesee wɔn ho sɛ: Onipa bɛn ara ni na ɔhyɛ mframa ne nsuo mpo na ɛtie no yi?
Ahonhommɔne tuo
(Mateo 8.28-34; Marko 5.1-20)
26Na wɔkɔduruu Gerasefoɔ asase a ɛwɔ Galilea ntentensoɔ so. 27Na ɔsii fam no, ɔbarima bi a ahonhommɔne wɔ ne mu dadadada, a ɔfiri kuro no mu bɛhyiaa no, ɔnhyɛ atadeɛ, na ɔnte ɛdan biara mu, na mmom aboda mu na ɔte wɔ asieeɛ. 28Na ɔhunuu Yesu no, ɔteaa mu denden hwee ase n’anim, na ɔde nne kɛseɛ kaa sɛ: Yesu, Onyankopɔn a ɔwɔ sorosoro no ba, ɛdeɛn na me ne wo wɔ yɛ? Mesrɛ wo sɛ nha me! 29Ɛfiri sɛ waka akyerɛ honhom fi no sɛ ɔmfiri onipa no mu; (na daa na ɛkye no a, wɔde nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn ne mpokyerɛ gu no wɛn no, na ɔtete deɛ wɔde akyekyere no no mu. Na honhommɔne no pamm no kɔɔ anwea pradada so.) 30Na Yesu bisaa no sɛ: Wo din de sɛn? Na ɔse: Ɛdɔm, ɛfiri sɛ ahonhommɔne pii akɔ ne mu. 31Na wɔsrɛɛ no sɛ ɔnnhyɛ wɔn mmma wɔnnkɔ bunu no mu. 32Na mprakokuo kɛseɛ bi wɔ hɔ a wɔredidi wɔ bepɔ no soɔ; na wɔsrɛɛ no sɛ ɔmma wɔn kwan na wɔnkɔ wɔn mu. Na ɔmaa wɔn kwan. 33Na ahonhommɔne no firii onipa no mu kɔɔ mprako no mu, na ekuo no bɔɔ kirididi sianee ɔbotan kuronkuron no kɔguu ɔtadeɛ no mu, na wɔmemee. 34Na wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn soɔ no hunuu deɛ asie no, wɔdwanee, na wɔkɔkaa no kuro no ne nkuraaseɛ mu. 35Na wɔfirii adi bɛhwɛɛ deɛ asie; na wɔbaa Yesu nkyɛn, na wɔbɛhunuu onipa a ahonhommɔne firii ne mu kɔeɛ no sɛ ɔte Yesu nan ase fira ntoma a n’adwene mu ateɛ; na wɔsuroe. 36Na wɔn nso a wɔhunuiɛ no kaa sɛdeɛ ɛyɛeɛ na deɛ ɔwɔ ahonhommɔne no ho sanee no. 37Na Gerasefoɔ asase a atwa ahyia no so nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa srɛɛ no sɛ ɔmfiri wɔn nkyɛn nkɔ, ɛfiri sɛ na ehu kɛseɛ aka wɔn. Na ɔsii kodoɔ mu sane kɔe. 38Na ɔbarima no a ahonhommɔne firii ne mu no srɛɛ no sɛ ɔbɛtena ne nkyɛn. Nanso Yesu gyaa no kwan sɛ: 39Sane kɔ wo fie, na kɔka ade kɛseɛ a Onyankopɔn ayɛ ama woɔ yi kyerɛ! Na ɔkɔ kɔkaa ade kɛseɛ a Yesu ayɛ ama no no kuro no mu nyinaa.
Yairo babaa
(Mateo 9.18-26; Marko 5.21-43)
40Na Yesu sane baeɛ no, nkurɔfokuo no gyee no; ɛfiri sɛ na wɔn nyinaa retwɛn no. 41Na hwɛ, ɔbarima bi a wɔfrɛ no Yairo a ɔyɛ hyiadan mu panin bae, na ɔbɛhwee Yesu nan ase srɛɛ no sɛ ɔmmra ne fie; 42na ɔwɔ ɔbabaa korɔ a wadi bɛyɛ mfirinhyia dummienu, na ɔda hɔ rewu. Na ɔrekorɔ no, na nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo no kyere ne so.
Ɔbaa bi ayaresa
43Na ɔbaa bi a wanya mogyaguo mfirinhyia dummienu, na obiara antumi ansa no yadeɛ 44bɛfirii n’akyi bɛkaa n’atadeɛ ano nnwo, na amonom hɔ ara ne mogyaguo no twae. 45Na Yesu kaa sɛ: Hwan na ɔkaa me? Na wɔn nyinaa resan no, Petro kaa sɛ: Owura, nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo no akyere wo so, na wɔremia wo. 46Na Yesu se: Obi aka me, na mahunu sɛ ahoɔden bi afiri me mu kɔ. 47Na ɔbaa no hunuu sɛ ada adi no, ɔde ahopopoɔ ba bɛhwee n’anim, na ɔkaa adekodeɛ a enti ɔkɔkaa no ne sɛdeɛ ne ho sanee no amonom hɔ ara no kyerɛɛ no ɔman no nyinaa anim. 48#Luk 7.50 Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɔbabaa, wo gyidie agye wo nkwa, kɔ asomdwoeɛ mu!
Yairo babaa wunyane
49Na ɔrekasa no, obi firi hyiadan mu panin no fie bɛkaa sɛ: Wo babaa no awu, nha kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ no! 50Na Yesu teeɛ no, ɔbuaa no sɛ: Nsuro, gye di ara, na ɔbɛnya nkwa. 51Na ɔbaa fie hɔ no, wamma obiara ankɔ mu, gye Petro, Yohane, Yakobo ne abɔfra no agya ne ne na. 52#Luk 7.13 Na wɔn nyinaa resu, na wɔregyam no. Na ɔse: Monnsu! Na ɔnwui, na wada. 53Na wɔseree no, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔnim sɛ wawu. 54Na ɔsɔɔ ne nsa frɛɛ no sɛ: Abɔfra, nyane! 55Na ne honhom sane baa bio, na ɔsɔree ntɛmntɛm; na ɔhyɛɛ sɛ wɔmma no biribi nni. 56#Luk 5.14; Mar 7.36 Na ɛyɛɛ n’awofoɔ ahodwiri; na ɔbaraa wɔn sɛ wɔnnka deɛ asie yi nnkyerɛ obiara.

Na ɛbaa sɛ yei akyiri no, ɔkɔfaa nkuro ne nkuraa nyinaa mu, kaa Nyankopɔn ahennie ho asɛmpa kyerɛe, na dummienu no ka ne ho, ne mmaa bi a wasa wɔn ahonhommɔne ne ahoɔmmerɛ, wɔn ne Maria a wɔfrɛ no Magdalene a ɔtuu ahonhommɔne nson firii ne mu no ne Yohana, Herode fiepanin Kusa yere, ne Susana ne afoforɔ bebree a wɔde wɔn ahodeɛ bi somm no.


Na nkurɔfokuo pii boaboaa wɔn ano ne wɔn a wɔfiri nkuro no nyinaa mu baa ne nkyɛn no, ɔbuu wɔn bɛ sɛ: Ogufoɔ bi firii adi kɔguu n’aba. Na ɔreguo no, ebi kɔguu kwankyɛn; na wɔtiatiaa so, na ewiem nnomaa bɛsosɔe. Na ebi kɔguu ɔbotan so; na ɛfifiriiɛ no, ɛhyee, ɛfiri sɛ ɛnni fonwunu ntira. Na ebi kɔguu nkasɛɛ mu; na nkasɛɛ no ne no fifirii, na ɛmiaa no. Na ebi kɔguu asase pa mu; na ɛfifirii, na ɛsoo aba ahodoɔ ɔha. Na ɔkaa saa no, ɔteaa mu sɛ: Deɛ ɔwɔ aso bɛtie no, ma no ntie!

Na n’asuafoɔ no bisaa no sɛ: Ɛbɛ yi ase ne sɛn? Na ɔse: Mo deɛ, wɔde ama mo sɛ monhunu Nyankopɔn ahennie mu ahuntasɛm no; na wɔn a aka deɛ, wɔde ama wɔn mmebuo mu,
na wɔahunu, na wɔanhunu mu,
na wɔate, nanso wɔante aseɛ.
Na ɛbɛ no ni: Aba a wɔguo no ne Nyankopɔn asɛm. Ɔkwankyɛn deɛ no ne wɔn a wɔteɛ; na ɔbonsam ba bɛyi asɛm no firi wɔn akoma mu, na wɔannye anni na wɔannye wɔn nkwa. Ɔbotan so deɛ no ne wɔn a wɔte asɛm no a, wɔde anigyeɛ gyeɛ, nanso yeinom nni nhini, na wɔgye di ma no kyɛre kakra, na sɔhwɛ berɛ ba a, na wɔagyae. Na deɛ ɛguu nkasɛɛ mu no ne wɔn a wɔteɛ, na wɔnam asetena yi mu dadwene ne haw ne ahonya ne anigyedeɛ mu na ɛmia wɔn, na wɔn aba no mmere nwie. Na asase pa mu deɛ no ne wɔn a wɔde akoma pa a ɛyɛ te asɛm no, na wɔde sie, na wɔnam boasetɔ mu so aba.


Na obi nsɔ kanea mfa adeɛ nkata so, anaasɛ ɔmfa nsi mpa ase; na mmom ɔde si kaneadua so, na wɔn a wɔkɔ mu hɔ ahunu kanea no. Na biribi nni kokoam a wɔrenyi no adie, na ahunta a wɔrenhunu, na ɛrenna adie. Enti monhwɛ yie sɛdeɛ mote asɛm no fa. Na obiara a ɔwɔ no na wɔde bɛma no; na deɛ ɔnni bi deɛ, deɛ ɔsusu sɛ ɔwɔ mpo, wɔbɛgye ne nsam.


Na ne na ne ne nuanom baa ne nkyɛn, na nkyeresoɔ no nti wɔantumi ammɛn no. Na wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Wo na ne wo nuanom gyina mfikyire pɛ sɛ wɔhu woɔ. Na ɔbua see wɔn sɛ: Me na ne me nuanom ne wɔn a wɔte Nyankopɔn asɛm na wɔdi soɔ.


Na ɛbaa sɛ da bi ɔne n’asuafoɔ no kɔtenaa kodoɔ mu, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Momma yɛntwa nkɔ ɔtadeɛ no agya nohoa. Na wɔhare kɔe. Na wɔrekorɔ no, ɔdae. Na mframa kɛseɛ bi bɔɔ huu baa ɔtadeɛ no so, na nsuo bu faa wɔn so, na wɔwɔ amanehunu mu. Na wɔbaa ne nkyɛn bɛnyanee no sɛ: Owura, owura, yɛreyera! Na ɔsɔre teateaa mframa ne nsuo no aworɔ no; na ɛgyae yɛɛ dinn. Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Mo gyidie wɔ he? Na wɔsuroe, na ɛyɛɛ wɔn nwanwa, na wɔsesee wɔn ho sɛ: Onipa bɛn ara ni na ɔhyɛ mframa ne nsuo mpo na ɛtie no yi?


Na wɔkɔduruu Gerasefoɔ asase a ɛwɔ Galilea ntentensoɔ so. Na ɔsii fam no, ɔbarima bi a ahonhommɔne wɔ ne mu dadadada, a ɔfiri kuro no mu bɛhyiaa no, ɔnhyɛ atadeɛ, na ɔnte ɛdan biara mu, na mmom aboda mu na ɔte wɔ asieeɛ. Na ɔhunuu Yesu no, ɔteaa mu denden hwee ase n’anim, na ɔde nne kɛseɛ kaa sɛ: Yesu, Onyankopɔn a ɔwɔ sorosoro no ba, ɛdeɛn na me ne wo wɔ yɛ? Mesrɛ wo sɛ nha me! Ɛfiri sɛ waka akyerɛ honhom fi no sɛ ɔmfiri onipa no mu; (na daa na ɛkye no a, wɔde nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn ne mpokyerɛ gu no wɛn no, na ɔtete deɛ wɔde akyekyere no no mu. Na honhommɔne no pamm no kɔɔ anwea pradada so.) Na Yesu bisaa no sɛ: Wo din de sɛn? Na ɔse: Ɛdɔm, ɛfiri sɛ ahonhommɔne pii akɔ ne mu. Na wɔsrɛɛ no sɛ ɔnnhyɛ wɔn mmma wɔnnkɔ bunu no mu. Na mprakokuo kɛseɛ bi wɔ hɔ a wɔredidi wɔ bepɔ no soɔ; na wɔsrɛɛ no sɛ ɔmma wɔn kwan na wɔnkɔ wɔn mu. Na ɔmaa wɔn kwan. Na ahonhommɔne no firii onipa no mu kɔɔ mprako no mu, na ekuo no bɔɔ kirididi sianee ɔbotan kuronkuron no kɔguu ɔtadeɛ no mu, na wɔmemee. Na wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn soɔ no hunuu deɛ asie no, wɔdwanee, na wɔkɔkaa no kuro no ne nkuraaseɛ mu. Na wɔfirii adi bɛhwɛɛ deɛ asie; na wɔbaa Yesu nkyɛn, na wɔbɛhunuu onipa a ahonhommɔne firii ne mu kɔeɛ no sɛ ɔte Yesu nan ase fira ntoma a n’adwene mu ateɛ; na wɔsuroe. Na wɔn nso a wɔhunuiɛ no kaa sɛdeɛ ɛyɛeɛ na deɛ ɔwɔ ahonhommɔne no ho sanee no. Na Gerasefoɔ asase a atwa ahyia no so nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa srɛɛ no sɛ ɔmfiri wɔn nkyɛn nkɔ, ɛfiri sɛ na ehu kɛseɛ aka wɔn. Na ɔsii kodoɔ mu sane kɔe. Na ɔbarima no a ahonhommɔne firii ne mu no srɛɛ no sɛ ɔbɛtena ne nkyɛn. Nanso Yesu gyaa no kwan sɛ: Sane kɔ wo fie, na kɔka ade kɛseɛ a Onyankopɔn ayɛ ama woɔ yi kyerɛ! Na ɔkɔ kɔkaa ade kɛseɛ a Yesu ayɛ ama no no kuro no mu nyinaa.


Na Yesu sane baeɛ no, nkurɔfokuo no gyee no; ɛfiri sɛ na wɔn nyinaa retwɛn no. Na hwɛ, ɔbarima bi a wɔfrɛ no Yairo a ɔyɛ hyiadan mu panin bae, na ɔbɛhwee Yesu nan ase srɛɛ no sɛ ɔmmra ne fie; na ɔwɔ ɔbabaa korɔ a wadi bɛyɛ mfirinhyia dummienu, na ɔda hɔ rewu. Na ɔrekorɔ no, na nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo no kyere ne so.

Na ɔbaa bi a wanya mogyaguo mfirinhyia dummienu, na obiara antumi ansa no yadeɛ bɛfirii n’akyi bɛkaa n’atadeɛ ano nnwo, na amonom hɔ ara ne mogyaguo no twae. Na Yesu kaa sɛ: Hwan na ɔkaa me? Na wɔn nyinaa resan no, Petro kaa sɛ: Owura, nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo no akyere wo so, na wɔremia wo. Na Yesu se: Obi aka me, na mahunu sɛ ahoɔden bi afiri me mu kɔ. Na ɔbaa no hunuu sɛ ada adi no, ɔde ahopopoɔ ba bɛhwee n’anim, na ɔkaa adekodeɛ a enti ɔkɔkaa no ne sɛdeɛ ne ho sanee no amonom hɔ ara no kyerɛɛ no ɔman no nyinaa anim. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɔbabaa, wo gyidie agye wo nkwa, kɔ asomdwoeɛ mu!

Na ɔrekasa no, obi firi hyiadan mu panin no fie bɛkaa sɛ: Wo babaa no awu, nha kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ no! Na Yesu teeɛ no, ɔbuaa no sɛ: Nsuro, gye di ara, na ɔbɛnya nkwa. Na ɔbaa fie hɔ no, wamma obiara ankɔ mu, gye Petro, Yohane, Yakobo ne abɔfra no agya ne ne na. Na wɔn nyinaa resu, na wɔregyam no. Na ɔse: Monnsu! Na ɔnwui, na wada. Na wɔseree no, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔnim sɛ wawu. Na ɔsɔɔ ne nsa frɛɛ no sɛ: Abɔfra, nyane! Na ne honhom sane baa bio, na ɔsɔree ntɛmntɛm; na ɔhyɛɛ sɛ wɔmma no biribi nni. Na ɛyɛɛ n’awofoɔ ahodwiri; na ɔbaraa wɔn sɛ wɔnnka deɛ asie yi nnkyerɛ obiara.

app.take_word: Take God’s Word with you wherever you go by downloading the free Bible App. Listen to audio Bibles, create Prayers, study with Friends, and much more—all for free. Choose from more than 2,400 Bible versions in over 1,600 languages on your computer, phone, or tablet.
app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
